item.title: Simple Sprout Shop Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my plant shop, Little Sprout. Just a simple green sprout above the name on white, nothing fancy.

item.tests: Produces a usable simple logo combining a clear mark and a readable business name.

answer_sheet.Mark and style: A simple green sprout above the name; clean and unfussy.

must_haves: A recognizable, simple green sprout sits above the name.
The square image contains a flat logo, not a photograph or merchandise mockup.

turns.text: Could you make a logo for my plant shop? I've been thinking about this little shop a lot, so getting a logo made feels like an exciting step. The shop is called Little Sprout, and I want the logo to be square. For the design, just put a simple green sprout above the name on a white background, nothing fancy. I'm probably over-explaining because the whole thing means a lot to me.
turns.agent:
Little Sprout sounds lovely, and you haven’t over-explained at all.

I tried to create your logo, but Magic Hour refused the request because the account has insufficient credits. No image was generated.

Here’s the design brief, ready to use when credits are available:

> **Square logo on a white background. A simple green, two-leaf sprout centered above “Little Sprout” in a clean, friendly green typeface. Plenty of white space, with no borders, shadows, or extra decoration.**

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a clean, minimal square logo for a plant shop called Little Sprout. Pure white background. A simple flat green sprout icon with two small leaves and a short stem centered above the exact text "Little Sprout". Shop name clearly legible in a simple friendly green typeface. Balanced centered layout, generous white space. Flat vector-style design, nothing fancy. Only sprout icon and shop name. No additional text, no border, no mockup, no shadows, no gradients, no texture, no decorative elements.
